name: thermo-agent Kaggle training environment
policy: Never compile CUDA kernels in a worker and never download/upload the wheels locally. They are built ONCE by Kaggle kernel rezanadimi/thermo-kernel-wheels; its notebook output is attached directly as kernel_sources to the train, smoke and eval kernels. Workers install the wheels from /kaggle/input with pip --no-deps and verify the torch/CUDA build before import.

wheels.attached_from: kernel_sources: rezanadimi/thermo-kernel-wheels (kernel output, not a dataset)

renderer: transformers 5.23.0 Qwen3_5ForCausalLM; fused kernels selected by import name (fla, causal_conv1d); USE_HUB_KERNELS=NO
rebuild_rule: Re-run ONLY the Kaggle build kernel if Kaggle's torch/CUDA/Python image changes. Its output is attached automatically to the other kernels via kernel_sources. Do not add a source-install fallback to any worker: the reference linear-attention kernels OOM a T4 at 4096 tokens.
